summary.name: Forgejo
summary.one_liner: Forgejo is a self-hosted, lightweight software forge (a Git hosting and collaboration platform) that can be run on your own server or used via Codeberg.
use_cases: Move away from GitHub to a platform you control
Run a small private git server with low maintenance
Collaborate on software projects with issue and project management
Host projects on a federated, privacy-focused forge
summary.what_it_does: Forgejo is a self-hosted software forge intended to be easy to install and low maintenance. The page describes a familiar GitHub-like environment for collaboration and project management. It focuses on security, scaling, federation and privacy. It is described as having a low server profile, needing far fewer resources than other forges. The project is developed by a community under Codeberg e.V. and states it uses only Free Software, and users can either create an account on Codeberg or other instances or download it to self-host.
notable: Lightweight: described as needing an order of magnitude fewer resources than other forges
Governed under Codeberg e.V., a non-profit; exclusively Free Software
Fork of Gitea, focused on federation and privacy
caveats: The page does not state a specific license; the awesome-selfhosted listing mentions MIT
Federation is described as a focus and goal, not clearly detailed as complete on this page
